Search tips

kasih finds the whole word family: kasih, mengasihi, dikasihi, kekasih

+kasih finds only the word kasih itself

[q]kota daud[q] finds these words in this order

Words that are not in the word list are matched letter by letter, so yerus still finds Yerusalem.
%1$d verses · +%2$d new · −%3$d dropped vs. letter search
No word was widened, so this search behaves exactly like the letter search.
\u201cBuilt-in only\u201d is selected in the Search Lab and this version has no word list, so words are matched letter by letter.
Rules only: word families were guessed from this version’s own words by affix rules. Expect mistakes such as kepada joining pada.
Smart search only knows Indonesian word formation, so %1$s is searched letter by letter.
“%1$s” belongs to the family of “%2$s”. Every form below counts, as a whole word.
Every form of \u201c%1$s\u201d below counts, as a whole word.
“%1$s” does not occur in this translation, so its affixes were peeled off until a known form was left: %2$s. That form belongs to the family of “%3$s”.
“%1$s” occurs %2$d times but has no relatives in this translation, so only this exact word counts. Words that merely contain the letters no longer match.
“%1$s” is not a word this translation uses, and peeling affixes did not reach one, so any word containing these letters counts, as in the classic search.
“%1$s” is not a plain word, so its letters are matched as in the classic search.
You asked for exactly “%1$s” with + or quotes, so its family is not added.
These words, in this order, as whole words.
Highlighted forms can never be found by the letter search, because they do not contain “%1$s”.
Faded forms are in the word list but never occur in this translation.
Showing only the verses the letter search missed.
Showing the verses the letter search found but smart search leaves out. They usually hold a different word that happens to contain the letters, like berkata for berkat.

Use only the word list built into the Bible version. Without one, search stays letter by letter.
Use the word list built into the Bible version, or affix rules alone when it has none.
Always guess word families from the version’s own words by affix rules. Useful for seeing what the built-in word list adds.
